title: Rider
direction: Use clean short clusters and sharper spatial changes. Keep one recurring motif in the rain pattern so the choreography feels intentional, then break it at the section transition.

sections.name: motif: opening
sections.note: Recurring cluster gestures move and change spacing without a beat grid. Measured note patterns carry the main surface; incidental weather is held behind them.
